name: Mpox
summary: Clade Ib mpox spreads in the UK through community transmission; UK clade Ib cases exceed clade IIb since July
state: UKHSA's overview of 8 Oct counts 226 confirmed clade Ib cases in the UK since 2023, with community as well as imported cases, and clade Ib outnumbering clade IIb since July 2026. Searches to 10 Nov found no newer global count and no mpox emergency of international concern in force, so clade I spread outside Africa keeps this at Watch.
for_you: Clade Ib is spreading in the UK mainly through sexual networks. UKHSA and NHS sexual health services advise vaccination for eligible groups and seeking testing for any unexplained rash.
rubric_hit: Clade Ib spreading outside Africa (UK community cases); no PHEIC in effect

sources.title: UKHSA — Mpox outbreak: epidemiological overview, 8 October 2026

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.

rubric.alert: PHEIC in effect with accelerating growth.
rubric.watch: Clade I spreading outside Africa or a regional surge.
